parameters.text:
=You extract data from a CV. Return ONLY valid JSON, with no comments
and no markdown. Use null when a field is missing. Do not invent anything,
except "secteur" and "annees_experience" (see rules).
Keep the original language of the CV.

Rules:
- "secteur": the employer's general business sector in one or two words
  (e.g. "Banque", "Industrie", "Mutuelle / santé"). Never the company name.
- "environnement": tools and technologies used in that experience.
- "annees_experience": total years of work experience, as a number.
- "competences": only hard skills: tools, programming languages, technologies, methods and domain knowledge (e.g. "Power BI", "SQL", "Agile Scrum", "gouvernance des données"). Keep level indications, e.g. 'SQL (avancé)'. Exclude soft skills (e.g. "rigueur", "esprit de synthèse").
- "langues": keep the level as written, e.g. ‘Anglais (courant)’.
- "experiences": if the most recent experience indicates no finished date, assume it as still working, e.g. '2025 - aujourd'hui'.
- "liens": LinkedIn, GitHub, portfolio URLs as written.

Schema:
{
  "nom": "", "prenom": "", "email": "", "telephone": "",
  "ville": "", "age": null,
  "titre": "",
  "competences": [],
  "experiences": [
    {"employeur": "", "secteur": "", "poste": "", "debut": "", "fin": "",
     "missions": [], "environnement": []}
  ],
  "formations": [{"ecole": "", "diplome": "", "annee": ""}],
  "langues": [],
  "certifications": [{"nom": "", "annee": ""}],
  "loisirs": [],
  "annees_experience": null,
  "adresse": "",
  "liens": []
}

CV:
{{ $json.text }}

=You write an anonymous consultant profile for a client. Return ONLY valid JSON. Use ONLY facts present in the data below. Never add a certification, score, level, number or skill that is not listed. No promotional wording
(e.g. "reconnue", "garantissant", "expert"). If unsure, leave it out.

Tasks:
1. "accroche": 3 sentences in French, third person. Always use "Ce profil" as the subject; never "il", "elle", "il/elle" or any gendered word. Use the sectors, technologies and concrete figures from the CV. No name, no company, no school.
2. "missions": for each experience (same order), rewrite the bullet points keeping ALL facts, numbers and technology names (Power BI, Python, SQL...). Remove only proper names of companies, clients or people, replacing them with a generic term (e.g. "la banque", "un client industriel").

Schema:
{"accroche": "", "missions": [["bullet", "bullet"], ["bullet"]]}

Data:
{{ JSON.stringify($json) }}
